# QuietBabyGear

QuietBabyGear is a micro consumer research site that tests baby gear handling, cleaning, sound, and maintenance friction under real-world sleep-deprived parenting conditions.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://quietbabygear.com/
- Testing archive: https://quietbabygear.com/tests/
- Testing methodology: https://quietbabygear.com/methodology/
- 3AM Cleaning Test explainer: https://quietbabygear.com/methodology/3am-cleaning-test/
- Lab Notes: https://quietbabygear.com/lab-notes/

## Current Original Test

- NoseFrida vs Grownsy at 3AM: https://quietbabygear.com/tests/nosefrida-vs-grownsy-at-3am/
- NoseFrida cleaning reset notes: https://quietbabygear.com/tests/nosefrida-cleaning-reset-what-to-rinse/
- Grownsy warning card notes: https://quietbabygear.com/tests/grownsy-warning-card-backflow-chamber-drying/
- Lab Note: https://quietbabygear.com/lab-notes/nosefrida-grownsy-first-reset-notes/

## Editorial Boundary

QuietBabyGear does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment guidance, or symptom evaluation. The site tests product handling, cleaning reset time, noise, one-handed operation, and maintenance friction.
